note: Public list prices on the date, Linux x64, for the size each provider is tested at. Free minutes, plans and discounts are excluded from per-run cost. Self-hosted-in-your-cloud options (RunsOn, EC2, GCE) are priced all-in (METHOD.md, Cost): every resource the jobs use, measured per job by the collectors, plus fixed monthly costs spread over the reference monthly job volume.

blacksmith-2vcpu.note: per-minute billing; per-job rounding not stated publicly, whole minutes observed

aws-m8a.large-on-demand.method: selfhosted/aws/cost_ec2.py: billed instance seconds from launch to termination (60 s minimum) x the on-demand price, plus the root gp3 volume, public IPv4 and the instance's NetworkOut bytes x internet egress $/GB; plus the launcher host as a fixed monthly cost

fixed_items.launcher_host: one t4g.nano on-demand (us-east-1, $0.0042/h x 730 h) runs the polling launcher

gcp-n4d-standard-2-pool.method: selfhosted/gcp/cost_gce.py: job run time / U x (VM + boot disk + external IPv4) $/hour, plus the VM's sent bytes during the job (Cloud Monitoring) x Premium Tier internet egress $/GiB. No controller host: the pool is managed by Terraform, so no fixed monthly cost.
gcp-n4d-standard-2-pool.egress_note: Premium Tier egress to North America, $0.12/GiB (first tier; 1 GiB/month free per account, not counted)

runson-aws.method: selfhosted/runson/cost_runson.py: per job, measured: EC2 instance seconds x the spot (or on-demand) price paid, root EBS, public IPv4, S3 cache storage (object listing x expiry) and requests (bucket request metrics), internet egress (NetworkOut minus S3 bytes, which go through the free gateway endpoint), and the usage-driven control plane (Lambda, SQS, API Gateway, DynamoDB, CloudWatch Logs ingestion) split over the session's jobs; fixed monthly, measured from the stack: the always-on Fargate worker and its public IPv4, Secrets Manager secrets, CloudWatch Logs storage, and the licence
